bullet: Crash seen by the bridge (`F29.backend-crash-detected`), known bug.
script:
CC=$(control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/session --header 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' --expect 200 --print-header set-cookie | sed -n 's/^oh_app_backend_session=\([^;]*\);.*/\1/p')
test -n "$CC"
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$CC" --expect 200 \
  --check app eq qa-backend
CRASH_PID=$(control-agent-server api GET /api/canvas-extensions/installed/qa-backend/backend --expect 200 --check state eq ready --field pid)
kill -TERM "$CRASH_PID"
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$CC" --until-ok 15 \
  --expect 503 --check exception eq '503: Canvas App backend is not ready' --save F29.backend-crash-detected/crashed  # bug
control-agent-server api GET /api/canvas-extensions/installed/qa-backend/backend --expect 200 --check state ne ready
control-agent-server api POST /api/canvas-extensions/installed/qa-backend/backend/start --json "{\"revision\": \"$REV\"}" \
  --expect 200 --check state eq ready
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/echo --auth none --cookie "oh_app_backend_session=$CC" --until-ok 15 --expect 503 --check exception eq '503: Canvas App backend is not ready' --save F29.backend-crash-detected/crashed
